title: Modules of finite presentation are quasi-coherent; a quasi-coherent module is of finite type (finite presentation) on an affine open iff its sections there are a finite (finitely presented) module (Stacks 01BO, 01PB, 01PC)
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. (0) Every $\mathcal O_X$-module of finite presentation (defined below) is quasi-coherent. Now let $\mathcal F$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. An $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal G$ is *of finite presentation* if every point of $X$ has an open neighbourhood $U$ with an exact sequence $\mathcal O_U^{\oplus m}\to\mathcal O_U^{\oplus n}\to\mathcal G|_U\to0$ of $\mathcal O_U$-modules (Stacks, Modules, Definition 01BN). Let $U\subseteq X$ be an affine open and $R=\mathcal O_X(U)$. Then (a) $\mathcal F|_U$ is of finite type [pqf-def-coherent] if and only if $\mathcal F(U)$ is a finitely generated $R$-module; (b) $\mathcal F|_U$ is of finite presentation if and only if $\mathcal F(U)$ is a finitely presented $R$-module (one isomorphic to $R^{n}/K$ for some $n\ge0$ and some finitely generated submodule $K\subseteq R^n$, equivalently the cokernel of an $R$-linear map $R^m\to R^n$). Consequently (c) if $X=\bigcup_jU_j$ is an affine open covering with $\mathcal F(U_j)$ finitely generated over $\mathcal O_X(U_j)$ for all $j$, then $\mathcal F$ is of finite type and $\mathcal F(U)$ is a finitely generated $\mathcal O_X(U)$-module for every affine open $U\subseteq X$; and if $\mathcal F$ is of finite presentation then $\mathcal F(U)$ is a finitely presented $\mathcal O_X(U)$-module for every affine open $U$.

proof.text: Mathlib directly infers quasi-coherence from finite presentation, with its local-presentation definition of quasi-coherence (Stacks 01BO).

Map generating sections along restriction functors and the over/open-subscheme equivalence. These functors preserve colimits and the unit. Compose covers and transport local generators through the iterated-slice equivalence. Shrink the cover index type using LocalGeneratorsData.shrink. The private finiteType_pushforward, finiteType_pushforward_leftAdjoint and finiteType_of_cover implement this argument, including arbitrary-universe covers.

On Spec R, use the proved source declaration finite_sections_top_of_isIso_fromTildeΓ: a finite generating family gives an epi from a finite free sheaf, identified by tildeFinsupp with the tilde of a finite free R-module. Full faithfulness of tilde reflects the epi, and a quotient of a finite module is finite.

Given a quasi-coherent finite-type sheaf and an affine open U, refine its finite local generating cover by basic opens in U. Map each finite generating family to the associated Spec restriction, apply the previous step, and transport sections by the restriction linear equivalence. The basic opens cover U, so their defining sections span the unit ideal. Their section modules are localized modules; Module.Finite.of_localizationSpan' descends finite generation. This is finite_sections_of_finiteType, following Stacks 01PB.

Conversely choose a finite spanning set of sections. Its linear-combination map from a finite free R-module is surjective. Apply tilde, identify the source by tildeFinsupp, and compose with the quasi-coherent counit isomorphism. The resulting finite global generators transport through the open-immersion and over equivalences to F.over U. The trivial local cover proves finite type. Combine with the previous step in finiteType_affine_iff.

Use the already proved declarations of WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.FiniteDescent: finitePresentation_sections_top, exists_presentation_isFinite_of_finitePresentation, and finitePresentation_sections_of_isFinitePresentation. They give finitely presented sections from a finite presentation, and a finite global presentation on Spec R from finitely presented sections of a quasi-coherent sheaf. The forward source proof descends local presentations over basic opens, while the reverse applies tilde to a module presentation. Transport restrictions and presentations along the over/open-subscheme equivalence and sectionsRestrictFromSpecLinearEquiv. This proves finitePresentation_affine_iff without the finite-type-of-kernel node. The source module is sorry-free; its declarations are used directly, not restated with holes.

For an affine cover with finite sections, finiteType_affine_iff gives finite type on every member. finiteType_of_cover binds these local finite generators and shrinks their indexing type, proving global finite type. finite_sections_of_finiteType gives finite sections on any affine open. For globally finite presentation, finitePresentation_sections_of_isFinitePresentation proves the final assertion directly.
